scope: One fixed-PC ordered selected lane, actual hub and existing finite CDC queues, distinct0.9GHz core/1.2GHz hub/0.9765625GHz ledger domains.

extra_ports.existing_stop: Held through source request/ACK; source admission reopens only after validated ACK and explicit stop release.

packet.header_epoch: old epoch for both control packets
packet.header_tag: bit0=exhausted; bits8:1zero; pair(next_seq,exhausted) distinguishes final65535 accepted
packet.CRC: Existing exact478-bitbody, polynomial04c11db7, initial/finalffffffff, MSBfirst; parallel XOR form
packet.codec_cycles: One encoding edge and one decoding edge, same as predecessor

source_order: Inhibit new native service reservations with stop; honor already advertised room1/room2 late writes.
Wait room1/room2, current w_v and encoder pulse drained before enqueuing FENCE; do not require live owners empty.
Retain exact live(seq,tag) ownership while ordinary true DONEs drain.
Accept only solicited ACK with old epoch, PC/source, matching requestednext_epoch and exact sequence/exhausted watermark.
Compare ACK canceled identities as a set against every remaining live owner, including duplicate and foreign detection; counts alone forbidden.
Commit new epoch and clear isolated canceled owners only on validated ACK; no wd for cancellations.
sink_order: FENCE arrives behind all earlier WRITE frames in same ordered transport; validate stop and sequence/exhausted watermark.
Wait typed cancellation acknowledgments and every handed write's true completion; handed must be0.
Require authoritative ledger_epoch_ready, including fault recovery/refresh custody/read quarantine, not merely empty counters.
Encode real DONE with priority over ACK; ACK follows all DONE frames and enumerates live&&!handed canceled identities.
Commit new epoch only when ACK is irrevocably queued at enc_v&&tx_ready with no same-edge new fault, invalid completion or cancellation.
transport_reset: Do not reset native hub credits, Gray counters, CDC FIFOs or their pointers during warm epoch. Existing returned credits continue against the same transport capacity; no reinitialization that could double-count delayed returns.

communication_cost.additional_latency: Codec+CDC+nativecredit arbitration and actual ledger/read drain measured in full minimum fixture; no guessed fixed bound. Encoder/decoder edges already priced by bridge, new two control frames consume real finite slots.

state_and_area: Fence controller state/identity snapshot/comparison area sized by bridge owner before its RTL. No whole-graph simulation, no physical closure from packet or phase tests. Codec adds no state vs parallel predecessor; bridge control state must be included explicitly.
mandatory_negatives: Wrong or duplicate canceled identity set
False early readiness with handed writes
Delayed old data/completion cannot publish into new epoch
